title: Evaluating Online Moderation Via LLM-Powered Counterfactual Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of generated toxicity across different prompt templates against a ground-truth dataset (PANDORA) by normalizing the distributions into probability functions and measuring the Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence. This evaluates whether the LLM is artificially biased towards generating overly safe or overly toxic language.
